stemMarkdown: If 5 workers can complete a job in 12 days, how many days will it take for 8 workers to complete the same job?
solutionMarkdown:
The problem involves the concept of inverse proportion between workers and time.

When 5 workers take 12 days, we can find out how many worker-days are required to complete the job:
$$	ext{Worker-Days} = 5 	imes 12 = 60 	ext{ worker-days}
$$

If there are 8 workers, the number of days (D) they will take is given by solving:
$$8 \times D = 60 \implies D = \frac{60}{8} = 7.5 \text{ days}
$$
